paragraphs.source_en: From the very beginning, Ujinao had favored peace. But under the pressure of his father and uncles, he had never dared speak his true mind. Perhaps Matsuda Norihide, trembling before him now, shared the same weakness and was merely forcing himself to remain composed.

paragraphs.source_en: In this world, many mysterious forces govern the course of human lives. Retainers were supported with generous stipends for no other reason than that, when the day came, they might risk life and limb for their lord. Yet the result was precisely the opposite: once a crisis arose, only a scant few were truly willing to hazard their lives. In the end, the Hōjō clan had set out upon the road to ruin. But what could be done if everyone was timid and cowardly?
